responsibility: Provides the NetBSD/ELF operating-system layer for the PA port. It sets NetBSD predefines, CPP/assembler/link specs and entry point, adopts ELF/GAS local-label and jump-table syntax, customizes function declaration and external-libcall emission to preserve PA plabel semantics, and adjusts core ABI type definitions toward 64-bit-friendly `long`-based size types, making the generic PA backend generate PA NetBSD-compatible assembly and driver behavior.
